datasetLabel: SKCM fallback - skin topography (C44) with non-melanoma histology (8090/3 basal cell carcinoma)
scenario: Basal cell carcinoma (8090/3) of the skin (C44). The topography matches the SKCM rule (C44 Skin) but the histology code is not in the SKCM histology_codes list. For topography_and_histology rules, the fallback should fire when topography matches even if histology does not. Expected output is the SKCM fallback: a broad skin cancer CRUK label with no TCGA term.
